_comment: Fixed A/B task set for scripts/skill-ab-eval.mjs. Graders check what the skill claims to add beyond the bare model: its artifact contract (sections other svc tooling reads) and, where possible, correctness. Paid: run with EVALS=1 (default runner claude -p). Extend per skill before slimming or retiring it; a skill that ties the bare model here is a SLIM/RETIRE candidate.

tasks.prompt: Write a feature spec for: users can export their invoices as CSV from the invoices page. Output only the spec markdown.

grader._note: diagnose-bug's own brief contract (P2 Reproduction, P3 Root Cause, pattern scan, Pillar Revisit Audit / Coverage Matrix) plus the correct fix direction. Corrected 2026-10-10: the first grader used headings from an unrelated table in the skill.
